version: V63 request-form state transfer; preparation-only v1
purpose: Test the TT mainline request-form state-coverage hypothesis; normalized LoRA is a matched fixed-recipe mechanistic reference, not a separately tuned baseline.

data.training_source: Original image/question/reference plus frozen source-question-only derived views; never evaluation questions.
data.view_manifest: Private VIEWS_FROZEN.json; public metadata VIEW_ADMISSION.json; no medical QA published.

NORMALIZED_LORA_R1.update: V62 normalized two-scalar RMS unchanged; no separate tuning

C: CE(q0,a; add dk at pre-block21 final prompt position)
objective.k_schedule: step1 uses view1; step2 uses view2; alternate, exactly80 each
objective.loss_mask: All target tokens including EOS; no prompt or image labels; identical target token IDs for q0/q1/q2 required.
objective.gradient: Compute each full unweighted CE gradient separately, convert to CPU float64, arithmetic mean, clip global norm1 once, one scalar-RMS update per step.
objective.optimizer: beta2=.999 eps1e-8; output factor1e-3 input factor1e-4; no first moment; original TT canonicalization only; no added trainable parameters.
objective.effective_target_exposure: 160*N weighted target positions per arm;320*N raw target positions; same N for all views/structures.

state.extract: Frozen unedited model in eval mode, no writer or intervention; prefix-only (image + canonical chat prompt), no answer tokens/labels/answer-derived view text.
state.site: Input residual stream of decoder block21, before input layernorm and self-attention, final expanded prompt position p-1.
state.direction: dk=hk-h0, float32 detached constant; alpha1 fixed; no normalization, clipping, learned projection or other scaling.
state.shared: Same two directions per edit shared by both structures; extraction before either is trained.
state.modify: Clone block input; add dk only at q0 final prompt position; all other positions exactly unchanged; no in-place cache mutation.
state.teacher: Full sequence includes answer for CE, but direction was extracted prefix-only; p=first nonignored label, patch p-1.
state.inference: Remove state hook entirely. Writer remains ALL_TOKENS.
state.cache: Only frozen blocks0..20 may be cached; block21 and later always live; patch after cache return on clone; never cache patched states or edited-layer KV.

random_control.trigger: After all six main arms complete and unseen labels frozen, either structure passes C-versus-A AND C-versus-B full gate.
random_control.run: If triggered, run R for BOTH structures and all10 edits, otherwise neither; no selecting winning edits.
random_control.direction: For owner i and view k: NumPy Generator(PCG64(630022+100*i+k)).standard_normal(4096,dtype=float64); rk=norm_float64(dk)*z/norm_float64(z), cast float32. Record NumPy version and exact vectors before any main-arm training. Fixed per view, shared across structures.
random_control.signal_gate: For a main-gate-passing structure, C must also pass the same paired gate versus R; otherwise no semantic-direction-specific signal.

paired_gate.against: Each comparator independently; paired identities, not aggregate loss cancellation.
paired_gate.interpretation: Development screen only, not statistical significance, clinical safety, or independent confirmation.

scoring.old_scores: Immutable; reuse only exact question/reference/full-output triple with same contract.
scoring.new_outputs: Mix all unseen triples blindly with fixed seed630023; freeze labels before method mapping/decision; R later follows same contract without relabeling main arms.
scoring.new_scope_outputs: Same89 source/question/reference classifications; apply fixed V62-followup unsupported-source-assertion rule to unseen outputs; mark indeterminate rather than infer clinical exclusion.
scoring.no_scope_claim: Explicit negative denominator remains0; do not reinterpret NA as safety.

replay.A: Both TT and LoRA A160 must reproduce every parentV62 fixed160 loss trajectory and all219 raw generation tokens; exact loss/CPUfloat64-gradient equality for duplicate clean branch admission; otherwise engineering stop, no tolerance widening.
replay.Base: Reuse183 bound outputs only with identical runtime/image/question/generation config and zero-writer clean admission; no forced Base regeneration to repair mismatch.

budget_ceiling.budget_rule: Preparation allocates no execution time or storage. Future authorized execution must fit min(existing remaining deadline,4h cap); retries and R share first-model clock. Expired or insufficient inherited window blocks launch; no implicit reset from version/name. A new independent window requires explicit authorization and preserved historical costs.

stops: Any semantic/tokenization/binding/admission/replay failure stops all dependent arms.
Zero or nonfinite dk stops state hypothesis without scale search.
NaN, resource limit or deadline ends the run with partial/missing evidence; do not select finished subset.
No main gate passes: do not launch R; close state candidate.
R completes: report all arms and close finite chain regardless of sign; no automatic successors.
forbidden: No launch in this preparation task
No extra data, hinge, RL, second adapter, routing or alignment loss
No claim of pure-structure effect or independent confirmation
admission_status: STATIC_TEXT_PASS_ONLY; CPU hook/gradient and real-model checks NOT_EXECUTED
lifecycle: At most80 formal final states plus2 temporary admission states; registered consumers full free generations/save-load/bindings/scoring summaries, then exact-list retirement. Keep direction vectors and provenance as private small artifacts. No current files scheduled for deletion.
